# Synced AR output
Open the main graphics index.html with VS Code Live Server. Open AR from its AR output section. Keep both tabs open in the same browser and on the same host/port. Game fields follow the main panel automatically; AR only edits sources, alignment and graphic visibility. After 3 seconds without the main panel, game markers hide rather than showing stale data. Custom artwork and video remain available. This browser channel does not cross devices or separate browsers.

Local video playback requires no camera. Field placement uses manual alignment; real-time automatic tracking is not included.
